Here’s a mix‑and‑match lineup covering classic chills, modern scares, psychological thrillers, supernatural flicks, and even a few cult gems—so there’s something whether you’re into gore or mind‑bending dread:

| # | Title & Year | Subgenre / Notable Twist | Why It Stands Out |
|---|--------------|--------------------------|--------------------|
| **1** | *Psycho* (1960) – Alfred Hitchcock | Psychological thriller/ghostly twist | Iconic shower scene + masterful suspense; still feels fresh. |
| **2** | *Halloween* (1978) – John Carpenter | Slasher | Introduced Michael Myers’ silent menace; simple but effective terror. |
| **3** | *The Shining* (1980) – Stanley Kubrick | Haunted hotel / psychological descent | Overlaid mythos, haunting score, Jack Nicholson’s iconic performance. |
| **4** | *A Nightmare on Elm Street* (1984) – Wes Craven | Dream‑based slasher | Freddy Krueger’s burnt face and dream logic made it unforgettable. |
| **5** | *Poltergeist* (1982) – Tobe Hooper | Supernatural family drama | Realistic suburban setting turned nightmare; creepy “I see dead people” line. |
| **6** | *The Ring* (2002) – Gore Verbinski | Urban legend / cursed videotape | Modern retelling of Japanese folklore; chilling atmosphere. |
| **7** | *Hereditary* (2018) – Ari Aster | Family curse / cosmic horror | Brutal realism meets occult dread; truly unsettling ending. |
| **8** | *Get Out* (2017) – Jordan Peele | Horror satire | Social commentary wrapped in a smart, tense narrative. |
| **9** | *Midsommar* (2019) – Ari Aster | Folk horror | Daylight dread; ritualistic madness set against bright Swedish summer. |
| **10** | *It Follows* (2014) – David Robert Mitchell | Viral entity | Simple premise turns into relentless paranoia; retro synth soundtrack. |

### Quick Streaming Guide (as of May 2026)

| Movie | Where to Watch |
|-------|---------------|
| Psycho | Amazon Prime Video |
| Halloween | Hulu (HD), Netflix (varies by region) |
| The Shining | HBO Max |
| A Nightmare on Elm Street | Peacock |
| Poltergeist | Paramount+ |
| The Ring | Disney+ (in select markets) |
| Hereditary | Apple TV+ |
| Get Out | HBO Max |
| Midsommar | Hulu |
| It Follows | Amazon Prime Video |

> **Tip:** If you want a binge‑worthy night, pair two from different eras back‑to‑back—for example, start with *Psycho*, then jump forward to *Hereditary*. That contrast keeps your nerves buzzing!

Enjoy the fright! 🎃
